sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The source defines the Descript Audio Codec: SoundStream-style convolutional encoder (22M)/decoder (54M) with Snake activations, stride-512 embeddings (86 Hz at 44.1 kHz), 9x10-bit factorized L2-normalized RVQ (~91x compression), multi-period + multi-band complex-STFT discriminator, no k-means/restarts; open code/weights.

Reported numbers: 8 kbps Mel 0.93/STFT 1.60/ViSQOL 4.18/SI-SDR 10.75, beating EnCodec-12k on all four; matched-24 kHz 12 kbps Mel 0.74/ViSQOL 4.51/SI-SDR 12.51 vs EnCodec 1.15/4.39/8.44; MUSHRA beats EnCodec at all rates.

limitations.text: Still below reference MUSHRA; worse on environmental/glockenspiel/synth; balanced full-band sampling required.
